text:
1998 FIFA World Cup, nke e mere na France site na 10 June ruo 12 July, bụ oge mgbanwe dị ukwu na ọkwa asọmpi ahụ. Nke mbụ, ndị otu gbasara site na 24 ruo 32, nke e kewara n’ime otu asatọ nke anọ. Ndị abụọ kacha elu n’otu ọ bụla gara n’ihu na agba mkpochapụ nke otu nke na-amalite site na round of 16 ruo quarter-finals, semi-finals na final. Na mkpokọta, egwuregwu 64 ka e mere n’ofe ama egwuregwu 10, na-adọta ngụkọta ndị na-ele 2,785,100 na nkezi nke 43,517 kwa egwuregwu. Ụdị gbasara ahụ mepere ụzọ maka ndị mbụ na-abata Croatia, Jamaica, Japan na South Africa, ma asọmpi ahụ webatara iwu golden goal na agba mkpochapụ.

Ndị nwe ụlọ gara n’ihu n’agba mkpochapụ, merie egwuregwu ọ bụla ha gbara iji rute final na Stade de France na Saint-Denis, dị nso na Paris. N’ebe ahụ ha zutere Brazil, ndị ji iko ahụ na ndị otu kacha egwu egwu n’asọmpi ahụ. Egwuregwu ahụ nwere ihe dị egwu tupu ọ malite: Ronaldo, kpakpando Brazil na onye meriri Golden Ball dị ka onye ọkpụkpụ kacha mma, nwere ọdịdọ na ehihie nke final ma wepụ ya n’adịghị anya n’akwụkwọ otu tupu eweghachi ya. Ọ gbara mana ọ dara mbà, na-akpalite arụmụka na-adịgide ruo taa.

France jidere ohere ahụ site n’aka Zinedine Zidane, onye nyere goolu abụọ na isi nke mbụ, na nkeji nke 27 na nkwụsị nke mbụ (45+1′). Emmanuel Petit tinyere nke atọ na nkwụsị oge (90+3′) iji mechie mmeri 3-0 n’oge nkịtị, na-enweghị oge mgbakwunye ma ọ bụ penariti. France ghọrọ ndị mmeri, Brazil bụ ndị nke abụọ.

Mmeri ahụ mere France ka ọ bụrụ mba nke asaa meriri World Cup na nke isii buliri ya n’ala nna ha, nke mbụ ha. N’ebe ọzọ, Croatia kwupụtara onwe ya n’ụzọ doro anya, rute semi-finals na World Cup mbụ ya dị ka mba nọọrọ onwe ya ma mechaa nke atọ site n’ịmeri Netherlands nke anọ 2-1 na egwuregwu nke atọ. Davor Suker nke Croatia mechara asọmpi ahụ dị ka onye kacha nye goolu isii, na-ewe Golden Boot.
